claims: Mitch Johnson is the head coach of the San Antonio Spurs.
Mitch Johnson was named head coach of the San Antonio Spurs on May 2, 2025.
Mitch Johnson was named head coach following the retirement of Gregg Popovich.
In his first full season (2025-26), Mitch Johnson led the San Antonio Spurs to a 62-20 record.
Mitch Johnson was named a 2026 Coach of the Year finalist.
Mitch Johnson served as a San Antonio Spurs assistant coach for six seasons (2019–2025).
Mitch Johnson helped guide the Austin Spurs to the 2018 G League Championship.
Mitch Johnson is only the second coach in San Antonio Spurs franchise history to coach in the All-Star game.
Mitch Johnson took over for Gregg Popovich.
Gregg Popovich stepped down after 29 seasons.
Gregg Popovich retired from coaching in May 2025.
Gregg Popovich retired from coaching following a health issue.
Gregg Popovich became the San Antonio Spurs' president of basketball operations.
Gregg Popovich remains a presence around the San Antonio Spurs.
Gregg Popovich is mentoring Mitch Johnson during his transition to head coach.
